claims.claim: Xylem Q2 2026 orders reached $3.1B, up 42% reported and 41% organically, materially outpacing $2.336B quarterly revenue.
Management identifies AI infrastructure as broadening water demand across semiconductors, power generation, mining and other critical industries.

risks.risk: Revenue growth remains modest despite exceptional order growth, making conversion timing important.

unknowns.unknown: Durability and conversion timing of the unusually strong order intake are not yet established.

claims.claim: Q2 adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 150 bps to 23.3%, with productivity, price and mix more than offsetting inflation and lower volume.
Xylem raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $5.55-$5.70 while narrowing revenue expectations to about $9.2B and roughly 2%-3% organic growth.
Q2 reported revenue grew only 2% while orders surged 42%, creating a large execution test around backlog/order conversion.

risks.risk: Lower volumes and project timing can delay conversion even as margin execution remains strong.

contradictions.contradiction: Orders accelerated sharply while near-term revenue growth stayed low and full-year revenue guidance was narrowed.

unknowns.unknown: How much of current orders converts within 2026 versus later periods remains uncertain.
